instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375-degrees. Coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cut (unpeeled) zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick strips. Cut up the end strips and add to a large food processor. Reserve the remaining strips for lasagna assembly.

Add chicken and pesto to the food processor and pulse briefly. Scrape sides and bottom of processor bowl and pulse again to blend; set aside. In a medium bowl, blend ricotta with Italian seasoning, Parmesan, green onions and shredded carrots, using a scraper; set aside.

To assemble the lasagna, spread 1 cup of marinara sauce on the bottom of the prepared dish. Drizzle 1/4 cup of chicken broth (or water) over the top then top with 3 strips of lasagna noodles (uncooked). Spread half of chicken mixture over the noodles and drizzle another 1/4 cup of broth over the top. Add zucchini strips over the top to completely cover then spread the ricotta mixture evenly over the top. Top with the last 3 strips of lasagna. Spread the remaining chicken mixture over this and drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup broth. Pour remaining 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce evenly over this and sprinkle mozzarella over the top.

Coat the underside of a sheet of foil with cooking spray (so the cheese does not stick to it) and cover the lasagna dish well. Bake until cheese is bubbling, and lasagna noodles are tender (about 50 minutes). If it seems a bit too watery, bake uncovered for 10 minutes.
Let rest for 10 minutes then slice and serve!
